## GPT-5.6 Sol API

GPT-5.6 Sol is a large language model by OpenAI, available on the Venice API as `openai-gpt-56-sol`. The provider of this model may retain prompt data (though it is anonymized by Venice). For sensitive content, use a private model.

GPT-5.6 Sol is the flagship model in OpenAI's GPT-5.6 series. It is suited for complex reasoning, coding, and agentic workflows, and is particularly strong at command-line and multi-step coding tasks and long-horizon problem solving.

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `openai-gpt-56-sol` | Standard | Anonymized | $4.00 / $20.00 per 1M |

### How to use the GPT-5.6 Sol API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/responses` with `"model": "openai-gpt-56-sol"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/responses \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "openai-gpt-56-sol",
    "input": "Explain TEE attestation in two sentences.",
    "reasoning": { "effort": "high" }
  }'
```
